title: A Study on Compressive Properties of Carbon Fiber-Reinforced Nylon (ePA-Cf)
content: The ePA-CF filament is a nylon composite material with 20% carbon fiber which is considered as an engineering filament, additive manufacturing has presented a significant advance for the creation of prototypes and the constant search to characterize and optimize the mechanical properties of filaments such as PLA, ABS, PETG and some composites such as PLA-CF, PETG-CF and Nylon-CF [1,2,3,4]. In the medical area, additive manufacturing can help in the creation of splints since with the help of 3D scanners they can be easily made without causing pain on contact that traditional methods cause [5]. The environmental impact between a 3D printed splint with resins and splints made in a traditional way and the waste they leave has also been studied [6].
